review_comment: The 'from_yaml' function directly passes untrusted YAML content to 'yaml.load()', enabling arbitrary code execution. Replace 'yaml.load(content)' with 'yaml.safe_load(content)' to prevent deserialization of untrusted data.

The code directly deserializes untrusted JSON data using simplejson.loads(content) without validation. An attacker can provide malicious input that leads to arbitrary code execution. Add input validation and sanitization before deserialization.
